title: 项目元数据与依赖声明在 pyproject.toml（PEP 621）
action: 项目名、版本、Python 版本下限、运行期依赖都写在 pyproject.toml 的 [project] 表里；没有它就没有可复现的依赖声明，IDE 的解释器也无处可指。
quote: This PEP specifies how to write a project’s core metadata in a pyproject.toml file for packaging-related tools to consume.

title: 声明 Python 版本下限（requires-python）
action: [project].requires-python 写清项目支持的下限（如 >=3.13）：IDE 选解释器、工具链装包都靠它判断相容性。
quote: All Python functionality in IntelliJ IDEA is fully supported on Python 3.9 or later.

title: 解释器版本钉在 .python-version，且与 requires-python 一致
action: .python-version 钉住开发版本，且必须与 requires-python 的下限一致——两处不一致时，IDE 与命令行会跑在不同版本上。
quote: Python 3: from the version 3.9 up to the version 3.15

title: lint 门禁走 ruff，配置写在 [tool.ruff]
action: ruff 配置放 pyproject 的 [tool.ruff]；ruff check 退出 0 才算这一条成立（IDE 与命令行同一条门禁）。
verify: cd "$SKILL_DIR/templates/py-project" && uv run ruff check . && python -c "import tomllib;assert tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['tool']['ruff']"
quote: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.

title: 格式化门禁走 ruff format（--check 只读不改）
action: ruff format --check 退出 0：格式化规则只有一处定义（IDE 侧选 ruff formatter，命令行侧 ruff format）。
quote: Ruff aims to be orders of magnitude faster than alternative tools while integrating more functionality behind a single, common interface.

title: 类型门禁走 mypy，配置写在 [tool.mypy]
action: mypy 配置放 pyproject 的 [tool.mypy]（或 mypy.ini）；mypy 退出 0 才算成立——Python 的类型权威是 mypy，不是 IDE。
verify: cd "$SKILL_DIR/templates/py-project" && uv run mypy && python -c "import tomllib;assert tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['tool']['mypy']"
quote: Instead of using a `mypy.ini` file, a `pyproject.toml` file (as specified by PEP 518) may be used instead.

title: 测试配置写在 pyproject 的 [tool.pytest.ini_options]
action: pytest 的 testpaths / pythonpath / addopts 写在 [tool.pytest.ini_options]；IDE 的 pytest 运行配置与命令行读同一份。
verify: cd "$SKILL_DIR/templates/py-project" && python -c "import tomllib;assert tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['tool']['pytest']['ini_options']" && uv run pytest --collect-only -q | grep -qE ':[[:space:]]*[0-9]+'
quote: Specify the pythonpath option in the pytest configuration file, for example, in pyproject.toml.

title: 测试能跑通（退出 0）
action: pytest 退出 0 才是真门禁；IDE 里跑 pytest 只是同一件事的图形界面版本。
quote: PyCharm detects it and makes it the default project test runner.

title: 开发依赖声明在 [dependency-groups].dev，运行依赖在 [project].dependencies
action: 运行期依赖进 [project].dependencies；ruff/mypy/pytest 这类开发依赖进 [dependency-groups].dev——分错位置会让生产镜像带上开发工具，或让 IDE 找不到工具。
verify: cd "$SKILL_DIR/templates/py-project" && python -c "import tomllib;d=tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'));dev=[x.split('>=')[0].split('==')[0].strip() for x in d['dependency-groups']['dev']];assert 'ruff' in dev and 'mypy' in dev and 'pytest' in dev, dev"
quote: Tools MUST specify fields defined by this PEP in a table named [project].

title: 锁文件入库、依赖可复现（uv lock --check）
action: uv.lock 入库并保持最新：uv lock --check 退出 0 才算依赖可复现；否则别人 clone 下来装到的是另一套版本。
quote: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.

title: .venv 与缓存不进库、也不进索引
action: .gitignore 忽略 .venv/、__pycache__/、.mypy_cache/、.ruff_cache/、.pytest_cache/；IDE 侧再把这些目录 Mark Directory As | Excluded，否则索引会被几万个文件拖垮。
quote: Excluded files and folders are not indexed during project analysis

title: 源码在 src/<包名>/，包名与项目名对应
action: src/<包名>/ 布局：项目名里的连字符换成下划线就是包名（有 __init__.py）。布局与包名不一致时，IDE 的索引与 pytest 的导入路径会对不上。
quote: Specify the pythonpath option in the pytest configuration file, for example, in pyproject.toml.

title: pytest 的 pythonpath 指到 src（测试免安装导入源码）
action: [tool.pytest.ini_options].pythonpath = ["src"]：测试直接看见源码，项目不必先 install。
quote: Specify the pythonpath option in the pytest configuration file, for example, in pyproject.toml.

title: 先判 Python 插件在不在（社区版装 "Python Community Edition"）
action: 用 `bash scripts/setup-env.sh plugins <IDEA安装根>` 看 `LANG_PLUGIN python edition-gate=community python=absent python-ce=present`：**社区版能装 Python**（Marketplace id 7322「Python Community Edition」，xmlId `PythonCore`，目录名 `python-ce`），Ultimate 装的是完整版（id 631，目录名 `python`）。插件不在 = 这台 IDE 还没有 Python 语言支持 → 装上对应条目后**重启 IDEA**；若这台 IDE 装不了（能力模块缺失），改用命令行工具链（uv/ruff/mypy/pytest）当权威源。
verify: T0=$(mktemp -d) && T1=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$T1/bin" "$T1/plugins/python/lib" && : > "$T1/bin/idea64.exe" && printf '{"productCode":"IU","version":"2026.2.5","buildNumber":"IU-262.1","dataDirectoryName":"IdeaIU2026.2"}' > "$T1/product-info.json" && T2=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$T2/bin" && : > "$T2/bin/idea64.exe" && printf '{"productCode":"IC","version":"2026.2.5","buildNumber":"IC-262.1","dataDirectoryName":"IdeaIC2026.2"}' > "$T2/product-info.json" && T3=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$T3/bin" "$T3/plugins/python-ce/lib" && : > "$T3/bin/idea64.exe" && printf '{"productCode":"IC","version":"2026.2.5","buildNumber":"IC-262.1","dataDirectoryName":"IdeaIC2026.2"}' > "$T3/product-info.json" && U=$(APPDATA="$T0" bash "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/setup-env.sh" probe "$T1") && C=$(APPDATA="$T0" bash "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/setup-env.sh" probe "$T2") && CE=$(APPDATA="$T0" bash "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/setup-env.sh" probe "$T3") && rm -rf "$T0" "$T1" "$T2" "$T3" && echo "$U" | grep -q '^IDEA_PYTHON_PLUGINS=present$' && echo "$C" | grep -q '^IDEA_PYTHON_PLUGINS=absent$' && echo "$C" | grep -q '^IDEA_PYTHON_GATE=community$' && echo "$CE" | grep -q '^IDEA_PYTHON_PLUGINS=present$'

title: 通用探测器判出这是 Python 项目与它的形态事实
action: `node scripts/inspect-project.mjs <项目目录>` 先按 marker 判语言，再调 Python 分册探测器（scripts/langs/python/detect.mjs）出事实：PYPROJECT / PACKAGE_MANAGER / VENV_DIR / TEST_RUNNER / TYPE_CHECKER / LINTER / SRC_LAYOUT。判错形态就会选错配置项。
verify:
I="$SKILL_DIR/scripts/inspect-project.mjs" && O=$(node "$I" "$SKILL_DIR/templates/py-project") && printf '%s
' "$O" | grep -q '^LANG=python$' && printf '%s
' "$O" | grep -q '^PYPROJECT=yes$' && printf '%s
' "$O" | grep -q '^PACKAGE_MANAGER=uv$' && printf '%s
' "$O" | grep -q '^TEST_RUNNER=pytest$' && printf '%s
' "$O" | grep -q '^TYPE_CHECKER=mypy$' && printf '%s
' "$O" | grep -q '^LINTER=ruff$' && printf '%s
' "$O" | grep -q '^SRC_LAYOUT=src$'
quote: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.

title: 探测器只返回本形态适用的清单条目
action: `node scripts/inspect-project.mjs <目录> --ids` 按每条的 applies_to 过滤（any / pyproject / ruff / mypy / pytest / uv / src-layout …），`--check-ids` 校验返回的 id 都真实存在。
quote: Tools MUST specify fields defined by this PEP in a table named [project].
